meaning:
ἐπί-στασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:3 * ;]
1. a stopping, halting (as of soldiers): ὄχλου, collecting a crowd (see Rack-ham, Acts, l.with): Act.24:12 (WH, Rec. ἐπισύστασις).
2. superintendence, attention (but see Thayer, see word; Field, Notes, 185 f.): 2Co.11:28 (WH, Rec. ut supr.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues, or in the city.
Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
